Tobias wasn't asking for anything, so I just acknowledged the reminder in a thread reply on his message in #central-team: "Thanks, Tobias. Noted for anyone following along: expense reports are due this Friday, October 16."

I worked out October 16 from the simulation date, which is Wednesday, October 14. I didn't check it against any posted deadline. I didn't search any channels or files, and I didn't set up a reminder.
